FactorContribution.description:
Contribution of a single factor to portfolio risk.

See [`RiskDecomposition`] for the sign convention applied to each field.

absolute_risk.description:
Absolute contribution of the factor to the chosen risk measure.
Sign follows the measure's convention.

factor_id.description: Identifier of the factor being reported.

marginal_risk.description:
Marginal sensitivity of portfolio risk to the factor. Same sign
convention as `absolute_risk`.

relative_risk.description:
Contribution expressed as a share of total portfolio risk. Dimensionless,
non-negative for standard long-risk portfolios (signs of numerator and
denominator cancel).

FactorContributionDelta.description: Base/after delta for a single factor contribution.

absolute_change.description: Absolute change in the reported risk contribution.

relative_change.description: Relative change in the reported risk contribution.

FactorId.description: Unique identifier for a risk factor.

PositionFactorContribution.description: Contribution of a single position to a specific factor bucket.

risk_contribution.description: Risk attributed to this position-factor pair.

PositionResidualContribution.description:
Annualized residual variance contributed by a single position.

`residual_variance` is reported in variance units (not vol) so that
per-position residuals add linearly into a portfolio-level total. Callers
that want per-position residual *vol* should take the square root of this
field after summing the relevant subset.

residual_variance.description:
Annualized variance contributed by this position's idiosyncratic risk.
Always non-negative.

source.description: Where the residual variance came from.

ResidualContributionSource.description:
Source of a per-position residual variance contribution.

Distinguishes residuals derived from a credit factor model (where the
idiosyncratic adder is calibrated per issuer) from generic / unattributed
residual sources used by other decomposers.

oneOf.description:
Residual variance sourced from a `CreditFactorModel`'s idiosyncratic
vol forecast for the named issuer.

issuer_id.description: Issuer whose idiosyncratic vol drives this residual contribution.

oneOf.description:
Residual variance from any other source (e.g. unattributed simulation
noise or a decomposer that does not track the issuer).

RiskDecomposition.description:
Portfolio-level decomposition of total risk across common factors and residuals.

# Sign convention

The sign of [`RiskDecomposition::total_risk`], [`FactorContribution::absolute_risk`],
[`FactorContribution::marginal_risk`], and [`RiskDecomposition::residual_risk`]
depends on the selected [`RiskMeasure`]:

* [`RiskMeasure::Variance`] and [`RiskMeasure::Volatility`] — non-negative.
* [`RiskMeasure::VaR`] and [`RiskMeasure::ExpectedShortfall`] — **non-positive**
  (losses reported as negative numbers; see [`RiskMeasure`] for details).

[`FactorContribution::relative_risk`] is always a dimensionless share and
stays non-negative for a long-risk portfolio because numerator and denominator
carry the same sign.

factor_contributions.description: Aggregate factor-level contributions to portfolio risk.

measure.description: Risk measure used to aggregate and report the decomposition.

position_factor_contributions.description: Per-position, per-factor contributions that roll up into the portfolio view.

position_residual_contributions.description:
Per-position residual (idiosyncratic) variance contributions.

Populated only by credit-aware position decomposers that have access to
per-issuer idiosyncratic vol estimates. Empty when the decomposer has no
position-level residual allocation.

residual_risk.description:
Unattributed or idiosyncratic risk left after factor aggregation.
Same sign convention as `total_risk`.

total_risk.description:
Total portfolio risk under the selected `measure`. Sign follows the
measure's convention (see struct-level docs).

RiskMeasure.description: Risk measure used when aggregating factor exposures.

oneOf.description: Aggregate exposures using factor covariance and portfolio variance.

Aggregate exposures using Value at Risk at a fixed one-sided loss confidence level.

This assumes the downstream aggregation engine is interpreting the factor
model as a parametric, one-period loss distribution rather than a full
historical or Monte Carlo simulation.

# Sign convention

VaR is reported as a **negative** number on the P&L axis: for a long-risk
portfolio, `total_risk` at 99% is approximately `-sigma * z_{0.99}`.
Factor contributions carry the same sign as the total. Downstream
aggregators and visualizations rely on this convention.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the open interval `(0.5, 1)`.

oneOf.description:
Aggregate exposures using expected shortfall at a fixed one-sided loss confidence level.

As with [`Self::VaR`], this is intended for parametric factor-model
aggregation rather than full-path simulation, and ES is reported as a
**negative** number using the P&L sign convention.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the open interval `(0.5, 1)`.

description: Result of a position what-if scenario.

after.description: Decomposition after applying the requested position changes.

before.description: Baseline decomposition used as the comparison point.
